CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION MEMORANDUM
Alpine IT Solutions LLC
Denver, Colorado  |  Managed IT Services & Cybersecurity
1. Business Overview
Alpine IT Solutions LLC was founded in 2014 and has operated for 12 years as a Managed Service Provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses across the Denver metropolitan area. The company provides managed IT infrastructure, cloud services (Microsoft 365 / Azure), cybersecurity monitoring and response, helpdesk support, and IT project implementation.
The company generates approximately 67% of its revenue from recurring Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) contracts under managed service agreements (MSAs) with terms of 1-3 years. The remaining 33% is project-based work and hardware/software resale.
TTM revenue of $2,410,000 reflects 10.6% growth over the prior year, continuing a consistent 10%+ annual growth rate since 2020. EBITDA margin is approximately 34% and the balance sheet carries zero long-term debt.
2. Services
Managed IT services (helpdesk, monitoring, patching, endpoint management)
Cybersecurity: SOC monitoring, EDR, email security, vulnerability scanning
Cloud services: Microsoft 365, Azure infrastructure, migration projects
Backup & disaster recovery (Datto / Acronis)
Network design, installation, and management
IT consulting and vCIO services for growth-stage clients
Hardware and software procurement and resale
3. Financial Highlights
4. Operations
The company employs 8 full-time staff: the owner (acting as lead engineer and technical director), 2 senior network engineers, 2 helpdesk/support technicians, 1 cybersecurity specialist, 1 project manager, and 1 admin/billing coordinator.
Client support is delivered via a ConnectWise-based PSA platform (ticket tracking, SLA management) and Datto RMM for remote monitoring and management. All client environments are monitored 24/7 with alerting and automated response protocols.
5. Customer Overview
Alpine IT Solutions serves 27 active managed services clients and approximately 14 project/T&M clients. The MRR base of approximately $133,500/month generates $1.6M in annual recurring revenue.
Apex Financial Group is the largest single client, representing approximately 18% of MRR revenue. Their contract runs through May 2027.
Client retention rate: 94% year-over-year on managed service agreements — above industry average.
6. Growth Opportunities
Expanding cybersecurity services — fastest-growing demand segment for SMB clients
Adding healthcare vertical — HIPAA compliance and EHR management represent significant demand
Hiring one additional senior engineer to increase capacity (currently near capacity at 8 FTE)
Geographic expansion to Colorado Springs / Fort Collins
7. Reason for Sale
The owner, age 44, is selling to pursue a larger business opportunity in the Pacific Northwest. The owner has operated the business without a co-owner or partner since founding and wishes to complete a sale before relocating. This is not a distress sale — revenue and EBITDA are at all-time highs.
8. Transaction Details
9. Risk Disclosures
This memorandum was prepared by the seller and is believed to be accurate. All financial figures are unaudited. Buyers are encouraged to conduct independent due diligence.

**EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT**
**Alpine IT Solutions LLC**
Senior Network Engineer
This Employment Agreement is entered into as of March 15, 2021, between Alpine IT Solutions LLC ("Company") and Samantha Nakamura ("Employee").
# **1. Position and Duties**
Employee is hired as Senior Network Engineer. Responsibilities include: managing assigned client environments; helpdesk escalation support; network design and implementation; cybersecurity monitoring and incident response; and maintaining documentation in the company's PSA platform.
# **2. Compensation**
Base Salary: $92,000 per year, paid bi-weekly.
Annual Review: Performance-based salary review each January. Target increase: 3-5% subject to company performance.
Benefits: Health insurance (80% employer-paid), dental, vision. 15 days PTO per year. Company-provided laptop and mobile device.
Certification Reimbursement: Company reimburses up to $2,000 per year for approved IT certifications (Microsoft, CompTIA, ISC2, etc.).
# **3. Confidentiality**
Employee agrees not to disclose any confidential client information, trade secrets, or proprietary systems information during employment or for 36 months following termination.
# **4. Non-Solicitation**
For a period of 24 months following termination of employment, Employee agrees not to directly solicit any client of the Company for competitive IT services. This provision is specifically enforceable in Colorado courts.
# **5. At-Will Employment**
This is an at-will employment relationship. Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time with 14 days written notice.
